description: Docs bug (same readOnly-id class as token policies): member create/update REQUEST bodies mark server-assigned ids and server-side role definitions as required. Create policies have no id yet — drop the member ({access, permission_groups, resource_groups} is the real write shape). Update policies may reference an existing policy by id but new ones cannot — make it optional. Update roles are referenced by id alone on the wire — description/name/permissions are read-only role definitions, so drop their required.
